reading_mode: retained original complete report reading plus all frozen-to-current differences and necessary context

reading.task_and_effective_requirements: Previously read completely; current task, requirements, effective_requirements and scope_decisions compared equal to the actually reviewed input.
reading.instructions: Read all current instruction changes; continuation explicitly permits reuse of unchanged reading.
reading.reused_reading: All unchanged passages of own frozen full-report reading and relevant prior source reading recorded in the first execution.
reading.limits: No claim to reread all original sources, independently validate every figure, rerun product tasks/calculations, or render the report.

independence: Continued in the original process_language reviewer context. Read only own previous response/execution and the assigned frozen/current artifacts, not other perspectives or author self-assessments. The earlier incidental production-handoff exposure remains recorded in the first execution; the parent explicitly treated that substantive handoff as normal research input and did not request a rerun.
actions: Read-only substantive review. Wrote only final response.json and execution.json. Preserved first review; no report edit, import, API request, new research, experiment or software test.
